title: Topology-induced Operators Reveal Complementary Graph Representations without Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.08152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph representation learning has largely focused on designing increasingly sophisticated models to transform graph topology into vector representations, or embeddings. However, the extent to which embedding quality depends on model learning, rather than on the underlying topological transformations, remains unclear. Here, we show that informative embeddings can be derived without complicated model design and gradient-based training. Propagating random features through implicit hierarchical structures induced by random walks and anonymous walks yields embeddings that capture node proximity and structural role, respectively. These two training-free embeddings preserve complementary aspects of graph organization and perform competitively with classic and recent methods across various node-, edge-, and graph-level tasks. translated_title: 拓扑诱导算子无需训练即可揭示互补的图表示
translated_abstract: 图表示学习主要集中于设计日益复杂的模型，将图拓扑结构转换为向量表示（即嵌入）。然而，嵌入质量在多大程度上取决于模型学习，而非底层的拓扑变换本身，仍不清楚。本文证明，无需复杂的模型设计和基于梯度的训练，也可以获得信息丰富的嵌入。通过在由随机游走和匿名游走诱导的隐式层次结构中传播随机特征，可以得到分别捕捉节点邻近性和结构角色的嵌入。这两种无需训练的嵌入保留了图组织的互补方面，并在各种节点级、边级和图级任务上与经典方法及最新方法相比具有竞争力。它们通常需要显著更少的计算量，从而实现了良好的质量-效率权衡。
tldr: 该论文提出两种无需训练的拓扑诱导算子，通过在随机游走和匿名游走诱导的层次结构中传播随机特征，分别捕捉节点邻近性与结构角色这两种互补的图嵌入，在多种任务上性能媲美现有方法且计算成本大幅降低。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two training-free topology-induced operators that propagate random features through random walk and anonymous walk induced structures to capture complementary node proximity and structural role embeddings, achieving competitive performance with classic and recent methods across node-, edge-, and graph-level tasks at substantially lower computational cost.
